take.en: OpenRouter for agent tools — one token, 3,000+ endpoints across 60+ providers, priced per call, no vendor signup.

explanation.en: Treg is an open tool registry and proxy built by the Superdesign team. Agents hit one base URL with one team token and can search a catalog of SEO, enrichment, social, ads, scrape, and media APIs by the job they need, not the vendor name. Hosted calls bill from a prepaid balance in fractions of a cent; your own keys, OAuth connections, CLIs, and SKILL.md bundles register once and inject server-side so teammates never paste secrets into agent configs. There is a CLI, MCP install path, Claude plugin, and a self-host option beside the live treg.to service.

why.en: Real agent work dies on tool access. Semrush, Apollo, Crunchbase and friends cost monthly seats nobody buys for a single run, and sharing keys across Claude Code, Codex, and CI is a mess. Model routers fix which LLM you call. Treg fixes which capability the agent can touch without ten signups or leaking credentials into every session.

howItWorks.en: Install the CLI or MCP skill, sign in, then search the catalog by task (backlinks, work email, TTS) and call an endpoint. One X-Treg-Token covers everything. Own tools win over treg's keys and stay unmetered; otherwise treg's account serves the call against team balance and returns 402 with top-up details when credit runs out. treg scan and upload pull shareable secrets and skills from a project so the whole team can use them through the proxy.

different.en: Not a model router and not a single-SaaS OAuth connector pack. The product is a pay-per-call tool marketplace plus a credential-injecting relay for your own APIs, CLIs, and skills — OpenRouter's shape, applied to tools instead of models.
